## Why BarkBox?

BarkBox is a monthly surprise that brings joy and enrichment to your pup’s life.

##### Obsession Guaranteed

Packed with wag-worthy toys and tasty treats, designed and hand-picked by experts.

##### Crazy Convenience

Delivering the perfect playtime directly to your door every month.

##### Personalized Play

Customized - from allergy-friendly snacks to toys designed for their size and play style.

## Frequently asked questions

What comes in a BarkBox?

Each monthly BarkBox includes two toys, two bags of treats, and a chew—curated to a fun theme.

How much does BarkBox cost?

Plans vary by subscription length and add-ons. Pricing is shown at checkout before you pay.

When will my BarkBox ship?

Your first box typically ships soon after you subscribe. Renewal boxes follow your billing schedule.

Can I customize for allergies or toy preferences?

Yes—many plans offer allergy-friendly treat options and toy size preferences. Availability can vary
by offer.

What if my dog destroys a toy?

We design for play, but every dog is different. Reach out to our Happy team if something misses the
mark.

Can I skip a month or cancel?

Most subscriptions can be managed online—skip a renewal or cancel before your next bill date.

Do you offer a happiness guarantee?

We want tails wagging. If something is not right, contact us and we will make it right when
eligible.

What is Super Chewer?

Super Chewer is our subscription for tough chewers, with durable rubber and nylon toys plus treats
and a chew.

Where does BarkBox ship?

We ship to the contiguous United States and other regions where offered. See checkout for your
address.

BarkBox is a monthly surprise that brings joy and enrichment to your pup’s life.

## Frequently asked questions

What comes in a BarkBox?

Each monthly BarkBox includes two toys, two bags of treats, and a chew—curated to a fun theme.

How much does BarkBox cost?

Plans vary by subscription length and add-ons. Pricing is shown at checkout before you pay.

When will my BarkBox ship?

Your first box typically ships soon after you subscribe. Renewal boxes follow your billing schedule.

Can I customize for allergies or toy preferences?

Yes—many plans offer allergy-friendly treat options and toy size preferences. Availability can vary
by offer.

What if my dog destroys a toy?

We design for play, but every dog is different. Reach out to our Happy team if something misses the
mark.

Can I skip a month or cancel?

Most subscriptions can be managed online—skip a renewal or cancel before your next bill date.

Do you offer a happiness guarantee?

We want tails wagging. If something is not right, contact us and we will make it right when
eligible.

What is Super Chewer?

Super Chewer is our subscription for tough chewers, with durable rubber and nylon toys plus treats
and a chew.

Where does BarkBox ship?

We ship to the contiguous United States and other regions where offered. See checkout for your
address.

#### Welcome to
#### PAWTASTIC FRIENDS

🐾 About Pawtastic Friends:

Pawtastic Friends was built with the mission of providing life-changing enrichment training programs
to homeless dogs. Through the dedication of our professional trainers and amazing volunteers, we’re
giving dogs in need the skills, confidence, and guidance to help them successfully transition into
their furever homes. 🐶❤️

 

Your donation plays a crucial role in this journey! It helps provide basic training, aquatics, or
advanced training to a dog accepted into our program. With your support, you’re getting them one
step closer to their happily ever after! 🏡✨

[FOLLOW US]

## July

# Adoptee of the Month

## ROCKY

[image0.jpeg]

Meet Rocky 💙

Once surviving on the streets, Rocky is now building confidence at Pawtastic Friends and making
great strides with his wonderful foster. From learning to walk on a leash to playing with his foster
siblings, this sweet boy is finally discovering love, trust, and safety.

# [*Sponsor
# Rocky][20]

[Click here to meet him ][21]

## OUR MISSION

🐾 Welcome to Pawtastic Friends! 🐾

 

Here at Pawtastic Friends, we are committed to a single goal:

✨ Making the world a better place for homeless animals. ✨

 

As a private, non-profit organization, we dedicate ourselves daily to providing enrichment training
programs for homeless dogs. With your generosity and support, we can work together to achieve this
mission and give these deserving pups a brighter future. 🐶❤️

 

Through the Pawtastic Friends Enrichment Training Scholarship Programs, our goal is to prepare
homeless dogs for adoption, giving them the skills and confidence they need to thrive in their
furever homes. 🏡 In the meantime, we ensure they are surrounded with love by providing toys, food,
medical care, and supplies to keep them comfortable and happy until they find their families. 🦴🧸

 

Thank you for being a furbaby hero today! 🐾💖 Your support truly makes a difference in the lives of
these amazing animals.

#### Welcome to

Pawtastic Friends was built with the mission of providing life-changing enrichment training programs
to homeless dogs. Through the dedication of our professional trainers and amazing volunteers, we’re
giving dogs in need the skills, confidence, and guidance to help them successfully transition into
their furever homes. 🐶❤️

 

Your donation plays a crucial role in this journey! It helps provide basic training, aquatics, or
advanced training to a dog accepted into our program. With your support, you’re getting them one
step closer to their happily ever after! 🏡✨

## OUR MISSION

🐾 Welcome to Pawtastic Friends! 🐾

 

Here at Pawtastic Friends, we are committed to a single goal:

✨ Making the world a better place for homeless animals. ✨

 

As a private, non-profit organization, we dedicate ourselves daily to providing enrichment training
programs for homeless dogs. With your generosity and support, we can work together to achieve this
mission and give these deserving pups a brighter future. 🐶❤️

 

Through the Pawtastic Friends Enrichment Training Scholarship Programs, our goal is to prepare
homeless dogs for adoption, giving them the skills and confidence they need to thrive in their
furever homes. 🏡 In the meantime, we ensure they are surrounded with love by providing toys, food,
medical care, and supplies to keep them comfortable and happy until they find their families. 🦴🧸

For 20+ years, over 30,000 businesses have trusted DaySmart to help manage and grow their businesses
with purpose-built software specific to their industry: Scheduling, communications, payments,
management, and more.

DaySmart’s Recreation & Fitness products power the experiences that move us – to achieve, to learn,
and to play. From after school programming, to youth sports, to fitness classes, our
industry-leading brands streamline scheduling, payments, communications and more for the world’s
best recreation experiences.

with customizable scheduling, communication, payments, and management tools—perfect for
veterinarians, groomers, pet sitters, dog walkers, daycares, and boarding facilities.

DaySmart empowers beauty and wellness professionals with an all-in-one platform designed to simplify
scheduling, payments, client management, and communications. Built for salons, tattoo studios, and
spas, our industry-specific solutions help you stay organized, save time, and run your business
effortlessly from anywhere.

Whether your focus is Automotive, Healthcare, State and Local Government—or any type of SMB or
Enterprise business—DaySmart Appointments makes it simple to implement efficient scheduling and
manage growth.

## Doggy Stylz Pet Grooming

Welcome to Doggy Stylz Pet Grooming, your trusted destination for top-quality grooming services in
Coral Springs, FL. Our family-owned and operated facility is dedicated to providing a comfortable

## About Us

Doggy Stylz Pet Grooming is a newly designed, modern grooming facility conveniently located in the
heart of Coral Springs, FL. We are family owned and operated and are dedicated to providing a
friendly staff and professional environment to you and your pet. Our beautiful and clean facility is
somewhere that you can rest assured that your furry friends will be comfortable and well taken care
of by a staff whose sole passion is for animals. As well as being comfortable you can be assured
that your pet will be pampered with the best shampoos and most caring hands possible. Also, being a
salon we are able to make sure that while you may be gone during the day your pet is under watchful
eyes until you return. Those of us at Doggy Stylz look forward to giving you and your pet a
personalized and enjoyable grooming experience that you will not forget.

### Owner and Head Groomer

Ashley has a passion for grooming and a love for all animals. She’s been around all different types
of animals her whole life from dogs and cats to pigs, snakes, ferrets and many more. Two of her
favorite things to do have always been taking care of animals and creating art, combining both of
these passions is what drove her to pursue a career in grooming. She first started grooming in 2011
after graduating from Merryfield school of pet grooming. After that, she focused on her goals of
opening a grooming salon. In 2012 that dream became a reality and Doggy Stylz Pet Grooming opened
its doors. Since opening, Ashley has poured her heart into making sure that Doggy Stylz is a place
that dogs not only leave looking wonderful, but they are happy while they are here. She along with
the other groomers that work with her at the salon truly have your animals best interest at heart.

### +What is the budget needed to launch a new product?

**Established brands: **If you’re already selling consistently, [reach out][49] to discuss a

**[Private Label][50]: **While the absolute minimum budget is around $2,000, most launches require

**New brands launches with custom formulation: **If your brand launch strategy requires a [fully
custom product][51] from the start, expect around $10,000 for R&D and sampling. Production typically

the $30,000 to $50,000 range, not including marketing and fulfillment costs.

### +What is the expected lead time?

Our typical manufacturing lead time varies from 4 to 6 weeks for Private Label offerings and 6 to 12
weeks for custom manufacturing, depending on product category, time of year and packaging and
ingredient selection.

For recurring production (1,000+ units per week), we optimize operations to maintain 4 to 8 weeks of
rolling inventory after onboarding.

### +Where are FormuNova products made?

All our products are manufactured right here in the United States. Our FDA-registered, GMP-certified
facility is located just outside of Atlanta, GA. We adhere to stringent quality standards, certified
by NSF, while ensuring fast lead times, transparent processes, and a product you can trust.

### +What are the minimum order quantities (MOQ)?

For established brands ready to own a one-of-a-kind product. We can transfer or improve your
existing formula, reverse engineer a benchmark, or develop a completely new custom formulation based
on your goals. Minimums may be higher depending on ingredient and packaging goals. [Learn more][52].

**MOQ 500 units – Customize Our Base Formulas**

For early-stage brands with some traction in the market, you can start with one of our proven bases
and make it yours with custom packaging.

**MOQ 140 units – Private Label Launch**

The fastest path to market for brands of all sizes and pre-launch brands. Launch in weeks with
ready-to-go formulations branded with your logo and labels. [Learn more][53].

**Tech Transfer / Recurring Production Schedule**
Enterprise-grade manufacturing access, without enterprise-level volume barriers. Structured tech
transfer with recurring production starting at ~1,000 units per week. [Learn more][54].

## Why Choose Furry Land?

At Furry Land Mobile Grooming, we deliver quality and convenience, right to your door. With over 100
locations across the nation, Furry Land Mobile Grooming is here to provide you and your pet with a
cage-free, grooming experience that fits perfectly with your lifestyle.

Busy schedule? No problem! Our state of the art mobile grooming salon comes right to you! I Our
online booking portal, along with our team of professionals, make it easy to schedule an appointment
that fits your timeline.  No more stressful car rides, just happy pets!

The Furry Land Mobile Grooming team is comprised of highly skilled and trained groomers who are
insured, bonded and go through an extensive background checks. We only use industry-leading
equipment and the most gentle and effective grooming products all resulting in happy, clean and
refreshed pets – that’s the Furry Land promise!  

## Our Total Care Grooming Package Includes

Health Consultations

at home.

Personalized Care: Customized grooming designed around your pet's breed, coat type, and health
needs.

Gentle & Attentive Touch:

Whether caring for a playful puppy or a senior companion, we deliver grooming with compassion and
safety at the forefront.

## Passionate About Pets? We're Hiring Groomers!

Let Your Pet Shine - Inside and Out

Experience professional grooming that enhances your pet's beauty while safeguarding their health!

Founded by a Professional Veterinarian 

Our grooming services go beyond appearance. Every session is guided by veterinary expertise to
ensure your pet enjoys a safe, soothing, and health-focused experience.


Our Services

Comprehensive Health Check

Before grooming begins, your pet will receives a quick wellness assessment to make sure each step of
the grooming process is safe and tailored to their needs.

Professional Grooming -

From stylish haircuts and gentle bathing to nail trimming and ear cleaning, our grooming plans are
personalized based on your pet's coat, skin, and overall condition.

Skin & Coat Care

We prioritize your pet's skin health. Using veterinarian- approved, medical-grade products, we help
soothe sensitivities and support long term skin and coat wellness.

Health Consultations

In addition to grooming, we provide expert advice on how to maintain your pet's health and happiness
at home.

Why Choose Us?

Veterinary Expertise: Every service is overseen by a licensed veterinarian for your peace of mind.

Personalized Care: Customized grooming designed around your pet's breed, coat type, and health
needs.

Gentle & Attentive Touch:

Whether caring for a playful puppy or a senior companion, we deliver grooming with compassion and
safety at the forefront.

## Welcome to Little Munchkins Mobile Pet Grooming!



Welcome to Little Munchkins Mobile Pet Grooming! We are a mobile pet grooming company based in
Plano, Tx with a grooming van at your service! We park our grooming van in front of your home and
groom your pets in our van so you don’t have to go anywhere!  

We are small pet specialists exclusively grooming dogs under 30 pounds. We are leaders in quality
pet grooming with the experience to back it up! Our core value is the comfort and safety of your
pets. Let us come to you!

**Benefits of using us as your mobile pet groomer:
**• Convenience
• Competitive pricing
• Consistent service schedule
• Biodegradable Products
• Nontoxic Products
• Integrity & empathy
• Experts in the field
• Exclusive small pet specialists

## Our team

Park and Bark LLC was founded in Austin, Texas by husband-and-wife team Ramon and Selene, who turned
their shared passion for animals into a family-run mobile grooming service. They first met 16 years
ago while working in the animal care industry, and today they share a busy, pet-filled life with
their two energetic teenagers, three cats, and a 10-year-old white Siberian Husky. Beyond grooming,
Ramon and Selene are also dedicated volunteers, lending their time and care to help local trappers
and animal rescue efforts. Their deep love for animals shows in every aspect of their work. As
Accredited Professional Pet Groomers and CPR-certified professionals, they combine experience with
compassion. Their approach is gentle, patient, and attentive—helping pets feel comfortable and safe
by tuning in to their body language and emotional needs. They focus on creating a calm, cage-free,
one-on-one experience that prioritizes your pet’s well-being, grooming quality, and overall
happiness. Always staying current with the latest grooming trends, tools, and techniques, Ramon and
Selene are committed to treating your pets like their own—because to them, pets are family.

**FAMILY OWNED**

## Your pet comes first!

**With over a decade of experience in the pet care industry, Park & Bark LLC is proud to be one of
Austin's highest-rated mobile pet grooming companies, trusted by hundreds of local pet owners for
our gentle, compassionate, one-on-one care. Every pet is treated like family!**
* ### 1. Service
  
  One-on-one pampering, premium products, and unparalleled service.
* ### 2. Luxury
  
  Luxury grooming for dogs and cats, delivered with love and care.
* ### 3. Happy
  
  We bring the spa to you, so your pet stays happy, healthy, and stylish.

## Services

### Choose local and small!

We're a **family owned** business that specializes in small to medium size dogs but will groom
breeds up to **75 pounds**. Our estimates are subject to change due to your dog's coat condition,
dry time and behavior. **Services Park and Bark LLC provides:**
* 1
  Bath Only
  **75 lb weight limit**
  * Nails Trimmed & filed. Shave pads (if necessary)
  * Brushing out knots and debris and undercoat removal.
  * Double Shampoo, conditioner, massage and hydro bath.
  * Blueberry facial.
  * Ears and eyes gently cleaned – ear hair plucked upon request.
  * Anal glands expressed (only by request).
  * Towel dry face and hand blow dry body.
  * Final brush and bluff.
  * Bandana or Bow.
* 2
  Mini Groom
  **45 lb weight limit**
  * Nails Trimmed & filed.
  * Brushing out knots and debris and undercoat removal.
  * Sanitary clip.
  * Double Shampoo, conditioner, massage and hydro bath.
  * Blueberry facial.
  * Ears and eyes gently cleaned – ear hair plucked upon request.
  * Anal glands expressed (only by request).
  * Towel dry face and hand blow dry body.
  * Shave pads and scissor paws.
  * Scissor up eyes and t-area.
  * Final brush and bluff.
  * Bandana or Bow.
* 3
  Full Groom
  **45 lb weight limit**
  * Nails Trimmed & Filed.
  * Brushing out knots, sanitary clip and undercoat removal.
  * Double Shampoo, conditioner, massage and hydro bath.
  * Blueberry facial.
  * Ears and eyes gently cleaned – ear hair plucked upon request.
  * Anal glands expressed (only by request).
  * Towel dry face and hand blow dry body.
  * Shave pads and scissor paws.

High Quality Materials

Reinforced Hemming

Reinforced hemming is added to all nets to create a longer lasting finish. PVC reinforced corners
can be added to covers for extra durability.

Made To Measure Sizing

We manufacture and stock a range of standard sizes to suit skips and trailers, however, custom

# Professional Mobile Dog & Cat Grooming

## Serving Broward County

**Available Monday to Saturday from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm**

### Hablamos Español

[ Book Your Appointment Online! ][16]

Ritzy Pet Spa, provides high-quality and affordable mobile pet grooming and non-anesthetic dental
cleaning services in Weston, Plantation, Fort Lauderdale, and all cities across Broward County. Our
Highly Skilled Pet Care Specialists will take great care of your pet in our top-of-the-line grooming
vehicle.

We have all the pro tools you expect to find in a modern salon: full bathtub with clean hot and cold
running water, hydraulic grooming table, multi-speed power hand-dryer (no cages or crates),
air-conditioning and furnace, vacuum cleaner, quality products, clippers, and scissors, and salon
stereo for that groovy session mood. We leave no mess behind.

Most grooming sessions are completed within 1/2 – 2 hours, depending on the dog’s breed, size, coat
type/condition, and temperament. –

## Ritzy Pet Spa Services

[Ritzy Pet Spa Groomers]

### Full Bath & Blow Dry

We use the finest quality shampoos for every type of skin and coat type. Blow drying helps to fluff
up coats, and jump-starts the de-shedding process.

### Haircut & Styles

Let one of our specialists give your pet the look and style they deserve.

### Nail Trimming & Grinding

We will trim your pet's nails to the perfect length for health and comfort. We offer nail grinding
for an even smoother finish.

### Ear Cleaning

At Ritzy, we can take some of the hassle and guesswork out of keeping your pet’s ears clean.

### Gland Expression

Your pet’s sanitary area needs to be cleaned and trimmed as well as the rest of his body.

### Flea & Tick Treatment

Nothing strikes more fear in a pet owner's heart than realizing that their pet is suffering from
fleas or ticks.

### Non-Anesthetic Pet Dental Cleaning

Regular teeth brushing prevents bad breath and prevents gingivitis diseases.

[ Book Your Appointment Online! ][17]

## Why Choose Mobile Pet Grooming?
1. **Convenience
   **Mobile pet grooming services come to your doorstep, saving you time and effort. You won’t have
   to worry about driving your pet to a grooming salon or waiting in a busy lobby.
   
2. **Reduced Stress
   **Many pets find the grooming experience stressful, especially when they have to leave their
   familiar surroundings. Mobile pet grooming eliminates this stress by allowing your pet to be
   groomed in the comfort of their own home.
   
3. **Personalized Attention
   **Mobile groomers typically work with one pet at a time, which allows for individualized
   attention and care. Your pet can receive undivided attention from the groomer, which can lead to
   a better grooming experience overall.
   
4. **Health and Safety
   **With mobile pet grooming, you don’t have to worry about your pet coming into contact with other
   animals or getting exposed to illnesses in a busy grooming salon. Mobile groomers take extra
   precautions to ensure a safe and clean grooming environment.
   
5. **Customizable Services:** Mobile pet grooming services can often be customized to meet your
   pet’s specific needs. Whether your pet requires a specific type of shampoo or a particular
   grooming technique, mobile groomers can work with you to provide a personalized grooming
   experience for your pet.
